svg.text: LCD and PCF8574 expander share the I2C bus (A4 / A5). STOP, buzzer and E-stop sense use their own pins.
MODE key: closed = REMOTE, open = LOCAL
5V → LED → 330 Ω → pin: pin LOW = LED on (~9 mA)
→ Uno power (barrel jack, or a 12 V → 5 V buck)
A3 ← 3.8 V = E-stop released · 0 V = pressed (or wire broken)
